actions.reason: K8_C0004 has a strong, coherent immune/inflammatory-down transcriptomic identity (allograft rejection NES -2.33, IL6/JAK/STAT3 -2.32, IFN gamma -2.21, IFN alpha -2.14, inflammatory response -2.03, all FDR q 0.001). Membership is moderately expressed in WSI (0.306) with weak positive CT/RNA support, and its decision-relevant boundaries are the most affirmatively represented in the partition: K8_C0004|K8_C0008 is coherent across all four modalities with moderate WSI/WXS separation (0.220/0.225), and K8_C0004|K8_C0006 is coherently weak-positive in all four views. The remaining boundaries (vs K8_C0001, K8_C0007, K8_C0002_M_K8_C0003) are weak-to-conflicting but none is merge-compatible, and no supported split or merge alternative exists. Biology plus affirmative boundary evidence supports independent retention.

K8_C0005 has a strong, coherent immune/inflammatory-up transcriptomic identity (IFN gamma NES 2.87, allograft rejection 2.84, IFN alpha 2.83, IL6/JAK/STAT3 2.29, inflammatory response 2.05, complement 1.90, all FDR q 0.001), the mirror-opposite of K8_C0004. Membership is weakly expressed in RNA (0.115) and not in CT/WSI/WXS, but its decision-relevant boundaries are not merge-compatible: K8_C0002_M_K8_C0003|K8_C0005 is coherently weak-positive across all four modalities (CT 0.095, RNA 0.052, WSI 0.029, WXS 0.057), and K8_C0005|K8_C0007 is weak-to-conflicting with WXS separation (0.397) and RNA weak-positive (0.096). No supported split or merge alternative exists, so the coherent immune-up identity with non-merge-compatible boundaries supports independent retention.

K8_C0001 has an interpretable metabolic-down transcriptomic identity (OXPHOS NES -1.97, FDR q 0.001), but membership is broadly unsupported: CT, RNA, and WSI all show negative silhouettes (-0.157, -0.149, -0.183) with high negative fractions (1.0, 1.0, 0.846), meaning most patients are closer to a competing label in three of four modalities; only WXS expresses membership. Its decision-relevant boundaries are weak or conflicting: K8_C0001|K8_C0006 is expressed only in WXS (0.584) with CT/RNA/WSI at ~0, and K8_C0001|K8_C0004 is weak-to-conflicting (WXS 0.426, RNA 0.063, WSI 0.058, CT 0.017). No supported split or merge alternative exists, and no remaining evidence could change the conclusion. Biology alone does not establish subtype validity when membership is broadly unsupported and boundaries fail to establish independence.
